description: Set the shared pull reference used by core/cavity (including side actions) and mold draft. mode auto searches icosphere and planar candidates, minimizing occluded undercut area and then maximizing drafted area. mode plane uses Top (+Z), Front (+Y), or Right (+X). mode face uses normal [x, y, z] in the part local frame and keeps its sign. Changing it recomputes those from the same pull. Read-only. It does not edit CAD draft. Molding rules: guide { topic: "molding" }. Long runs: an analysis still going after about 30 s answers { status: "running", stillRunning: true, jobId, command, phase?, percent?, elapsedSec, etaSec? } instead of the result. That is a heartbeat, not the result. Call mold_status { job_id } (it waits up to about 30 s each time) until it answers the result; the analysis keeps running in the tab and is not restarted.

mode.description: auto searches. plane uses an origin plane. face uses normal.

normal.description: Face normal [x, y, z] in the part local frame when mode is face. The sign is kept.

plane.description: Origin plane when mode is plane. Top is +Z, Front is +Y, Right is +X.

name: mold_pull
